Egg.time.type: ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
Egg.time.value: fun R α Tb T0 Tc => R ^ 2 / (π ^ 2 * α) * Real.log (2 * (Tb - T0) / (Tb - Tc))

Egg.FirstOrder.type: (ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) → Prop
Egg.FirstOrder.value: fun cook => ∀ (R α Tb T0 Tc : ℝ), 0 < R → 0 < α → T0 < Tc → Tc < Tb → cook R α Tb T0 Tc = Egg.time R α Tb T0 Tc

Egg.scaling.type: ∀ (k R α Tb T0 Tc : ℝ), Egg.time (k * R) α Tb T0 Tc = k ^ 2 * Egg.time R α Tb T0 Tc

Egg.colder.type: ∀ (R α Tb T0 T0' Tc : ℝ), 0 < R → 0 < α → T0' < T0 → T0 < Tc → Tc < Tb → Egg.time R α Tb T0 Tc < Egg.time R α Tb T0' Tc
Egg.colder.proof: by unfold time; apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left _ hc; apply Real.log_lt_log ...

Egg.fridge.type: ∀ (cook : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), Egg.FirstOrder cook → ∀ (R α Tb T0 T0' Tc : ℝ), 0 < R → 0 < α → T0' < T0 → T0 < Tc → Tc < Tb → cook R α Tb T0' Tc - cook R α Tb T0 Tc = R ^ 2 / (π ^ 2 * α) * Real.log ((Tb - T0') / (Tb - T0))
Egg.fridge.proof: by rw [h .., h ..]; unfold time; rw [← mul_sub, ← Real.log_div]; ...
